hits.snippet: - CEO Transition: Kevin Carlin appointed as CEO, succeeding co-founder Peter Howard who becomes non-executive Chairman. - Market Growth: Industrial AI market projected to surge from $5 billion in 2024 to nearly $50 billion by 2030. - Technology Impact: Resolver platform reduces engineering bottlenecks and program launch times for complex robotic workcells. ... BOSTON, MA – August 13, 2026 – In a move that signals a strategic shift from foundational technology development to aggressive market scaling, Realtime Robotics has appointed Kevin Carlin as its new Chief Executive Officer. The appointment comes as the industrial AI specialist sees its core technology, the Resolver platform, gain significant traction among the world's most demanding manufacturers. Carlin succeeds co-founder Peter Howard, who has guided the company from its inception and now transitions to the role of non-executive Chairman of the Board, ensuring his strategic oversight continues as the company enters its next chapter.

hits.title: About - Realtime Robotics
hits.snippet: ##### Kevin Carlin ... Kevin Carlin is the Chief Executive Officer of Realtime Robotics. Previously he served as President and Chief Commercial Officer. Prior to joining the company, he held a wide variety of roles in the semiconductor industry over the past 25 years, including leading the Industrial Automation, Energy, and Industrial AI-based SaaS businesses for Analog Devices. Kevin spent 15 years in Europe leading various sales organizations, including 12 years in Germany. He is fluent in German and holds a Bachelor's and Master's degree in Electronic Engineering & DSP from Ulster University. Kevin is originally from Belfast, N. Ireland and currently resides in Boston, MA.
